question: What are the most influential papers on CAR T-cell therapy? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers on CAR T-cell therapy, based on citation counts, include clinical studies on Axicabtagene Ciloleucel and Tisagenlecleucel, as well as consensus grading for managing associated toxicities.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1056/nejmoa1707447","title":"Axicabtagene Ciloleucel CAR T-Cell Therapy in Refractory Large B-Cell Lymphoma","citation_count":4671},{"doi":"10.1056/nejmoa1709866","title":"Tisagenlecleucel in Children and Young Adults with B-Cell Lymphoblastic Leukemia","citation_count":4449},{"doi":"10.1056/nejmoa1804980","title":"Tisagenlecleucel in Adult Relapsed or Refractory Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma","citation_count":3163},{"doi":"10.1016/j.bbmt.2018.12.758","title":"ASTCT Consensus Grading for Cytokine Release Syndrome and Neurologic Toxicity Associated with Immune Effector Cells","citation_count":3143},{"doi":"10.1038/s41408-021-00459-7","title":"CAR-T cell therapy: current limitations and potential strategies","citation_count":2492}]}

parsed.answer: The most influential papers on CAR T-cell therapy, based on citation counts, include clinical studies on Axicabtagene Ciloleucel and Tisagenlecleucel, as well as consensus grading for managing associated toxicities.
